exact_statement: For every finite uniform selector decision tree with no repeated query along any path and Boolean leaves on an independent common data cube, given complete leaf spectral prefix codes of expected costs c_l, there is a constructive cover C_l AND [g_l=1] and an exact joint spectral witness with a prefix code of expected cost 2D+sum_l p_l c_l, where p_l=2^(-d_l) and D=sum_l p_l d_l. If I_sel(F)>=gamma D and c_l<=K I(g_l), this full cost is <=max(2/gamma,K) I(F). For unsigned nonempty character leaves with repeated labels allowed, the leaf costs are zero and I_sel=B/2, where B=E_x sum_j 1[label(x)!=label(x^flip_j)]; B>=beta D gives full cost <=(4/beta) I_sel. The alternating two-label first-positive comb has D=2(1-2^(-a)), B>=D/2, I_data=1 and I_sel<1 for every a>=1, hence full cost <=8 I_sel while conjunction-cover read and a are unbounded.
hypotheses: uniform finite selector and data cubes, independent blocks
finite selector tree, coordinate never queried twice along a path
Boolean leaves on the common data cube; overlaps and repeated leaves allowed
leaf witness codebooks fixed before spectral sample, prefix-free, exact decoded Fourier law
gamma>0 and K>=0 only for the stated admitted general-leaf consequence
unsigned nonempty character leaves and beta>0 only for the character consequence
